svg.title: Object Model — TEM Tilt Navigation
svg.desc: UML-style object model of pytex.tem: stage position, calibration and tilt envelopes, the tilt solutions and paths produced by navigation, and the ambiguity reporting objects.
svg.text: Stage geometry and calibration, tilt solutions and paths, and ambiguity reports
composition - a required field: the owner cannot exist without it
association - an optional or defaulted field
inheritance - the triangle touches the base class
* after a field name: the field holds a sequence
ProvenanceRecord is omitted: 94 classes carry it, on every result object.
Fields naming another card are listed first; the rest are summarized.
